rationale: anchor_strategy.cpp: under the adapter strategy, a node with no source id falls back to a content hash; that fallback now counts the per-signature sibling index (over id-less siblings only) that the content_hash strategy already counts, so id-less siblings of one shape no longer share one anchor. The first such sibling keeps its previous anchor, nodes with a source id are unchanged, and no API or authority boundary moves. Pulp-only: it fixes Pulp's importer identity assignment, which bindings and tweaks in Pulp consume.
